cases.question: How many maintenance requests are still open in each building?
cases.title: Open Maintenance Requests by Building
cases.sql:
SELECT
  T2.name AS BuildingName,
  COUNT(T1.request_id) AS OpenRequestsCount
FROM maintenance AS T1
INNER JOIN unit AS T3
  ON T1.unit_id = T3.unit_id
INNER JOIN building AS T2
  ON T3.building_id = T2.building_id
WHERE
  T1.state = 'open'
GROUP BY
  T2.name;
assumptions: The current date is 2026-10-21, and we are only considering maintenance requests that are currently 'open'.
The request asks to group the open maintenance requests by the name of the building where the unit resides.

cases.question: Which buildings have an elevator and more than 10 units?
cases.title: Buildings with Elevators and More Than 10 Units
cases.sql: SELECT T1.building_id, COUNT(T2.unit_id) AS unit_count FROM building AS T1 INNER JOIN unit AS T2 ON T1.building_id = T2.building_id WHERE T1.has_elevator = 1 GROUP BY T1.building_id HAVING COUNT(T2.unit_id) > 10;
assumptions: The user ID 'eval' should be used when referring to their own information.
